title: Storyteller project settings
description: A file of kind project-settings: the catalog of the values a project's settings allow (type names, colors, icons, the default time zone and the date format), and how a settings document of any client is validated and normalized. Member names, type codes, colors, icons, date formats and time zones match case-insensitively in ASCII only (A-Z equals a-z, no other folding) and are stored in the catalog's spelling; Format matches exactly. Labels and plurals are trimmed of Unicode White_Space (U+0009-U+000D, U+0020, U+0085, U+00A0, U+1680, U+2000-U+200A, U+2028, U+2029, U+202F, U+205F, U+3000) and measured in UTF-16 code units; a blank label, plural, time zone or date format means none, null means none, and a type without any value is removed.

catalog.description: The allowed values, the single source of every client's lists. Lists keep their order: clients show them in it, and settings are written with the type codes in it.

format.description: The marker of a settings file (the Format member of a data set's project-settings.json and of sform's export).

typeCodes.description: The codes of the annotation types, the keys of Types.

builtIn.description: The appearance of every type code when the project sets none.

colors.description: The color names (the admin UI's palette).

icons.description: The icon names (Iconify names of the Lucide set that the admin UI bundles).

dateFormats.description: The date formats: yyyy the year, mm the month, mmm its English abbreviation, dd and d the day with and without a leading zero.

defaults.description: What a client uses when the settings have no time zone or no date format.

limits.description: The most UTF-16 code units of a trimmed label and plural.

timeZones.description: The IANA time zone ids of the tz database: every canonical zone and every link, the Etc zones and UTC, in ordinal order. Generated by tools/time-zones.cs.

settings.description: A settings document as a client sends it: any JSON value.

problems.description: Every problem that refuses the document, in any order.

settings.description: The normalized settings as the API writes them, without Version and Modified: Types with every type that has a value (in any order), DefaultTimeZone and DateFormat only when set.

problem.description: The JSON path the problem names and its rule.

rule.description: type-code: a key of Types that is not a type code, or two that differ only in case. label, plural: longer than the limit. plural-without-label: a plural without a label. color, icon, time-zone, date-format: not a value of the catalog. unknown-member: a member the document does not have. case-collision: two members that differ only in case. type: a value of the wrong JSON type (an object for the document, Types and a type; a string or null for the other members). format: Format that is not the marker.
